BiblicalUsage: The plow is named once, in Jesus' warning to the man who wanted to follow Him after saying farewell at home. No man, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
TheologicalSignificance: One word for a plow carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the picture, that following Jesus is forward work, and a backward look at the furrow ruins the row.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
